question: How long does abiding in the face of īśa last?
premises: as long as the lord makes
so long abiding in the face of īśa
in the unfolding of the undivided inward-abiding power of action
inference: abiding in the face of īśa lasts as long as the lord acts in the unfolding of action-power
plain_english: As long as the lord makes, so long is abiding in the face of īśa, in the unfolding of the undivided inward-abiding power of action.
